  - the existing `IsSplitWitness` consumer.
- Recovery-owned integration roots were preserved in [Pic0CriticalPath.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0CriticalPath.lean).

## Issues

The remaining blocker is the genuine arbitrary-affine, lambda-tied `NativePresentation` family required by `PicRankOneOpen/FibrePresented`: coherent datum/class ties on every affine pullback, cartesian native pushforward `IsIso`, H1 vanishing, finite/projective H0, and stalk rank one. No honest fieldwise or unrelated existential carrier can supply that endpoint.

The roadmap and task are therefore correctly `blocked`, with the producer request recorded through I-1927. Workspace-wide hgraph synchronization also reports pre-existing duplicate declarations/stale marks, and old lock artifacts belong to the separate I-1913 cleanup lane.

## Why I stopped

The translated producer and its `baseSubtraction`/finite-support/residue-one compatibility are complete, but the final membership theorem depends on protected Phase-3/Phase-4 interfaces that are not present. Extending those files directly would violate ownership, and fabricating a weaker carrier would violate the task’s mathematical requirement.

## Next

Implement the protected arbitrary-affine presentation family and then consume it immediately through `PicRankOneOpen` and `FibrePresented`, preserving the lambda ties and exact subtraction data. The high-degree Abel quotient and Galois-descent routes remain intentionally untouched.
I’m clearing the final protected I-1927 handoff now, then I’ll stop without changing source files or reopening the blocked objective.
